rows.title: 2.0 TSI EA888 oil consumption and timing-chain wear
rows.howToFix: Check oil level regularly between services and top up promptly with the correct VW 504.00/508.00-spec oil. Investigate persistent high consumption (worse than ~1 litre/1,000 km) via a dealer oil-consumption test; remedies range from PCV/oil-separator replacement to piston-ring/short-block work. Address any cold-start timing rattle promptly to avoid chain/tensioner failure. Walnut-blast carbon from intake valves if drivability/misfires appear.

rows.title: DSG dual-clutch gearbox failures: clutch pack / mechatronic faults causing limp mode
rows.howToFix: Have the gearbox scanned for fault codes (P175E00 indicates clutch pack 1). Remedy is typically replacement of the mechatronic control unit, or in worse cases the full DSG unit, performed under warranty. Owners should keep up with DSG fluid service intervals and avoid 'creeping' (holding the car on the throttle against the brake) to reduce clutch heat. If the warning appears, stop and restart - intermittent faults sometimes clear, but the car should still be diagnosed.

rows.title: Infotainment system freezes, blank screens and software crashes
rows.howToFix: Perform a hard reset of the infotainment unit (hold the power/volume knob ~10-20 seconds, or follow Cupra's reset procedure). Book the car in for the latest MIB3 software at a Cupra dealer - newer builds improve stability. If freezes persist after updating, the head unit can be replaced under warranty. Where available, accept OTA updates as they are released.

rows.title: Keyless entry/start and false SOS/roadside-assistance calls (electrical gremlins)
rows.howToFix: Update the relevant control-module software at a Cupra dealer, which resolves many false-warning and SOS cases. For keyless faults, try a fresh key-fob battery first; persistent non-detection or unintended locking is addressed by recalibrating or replacing the Kessy antenna/door handle sensors under warranty. Document any false emergency calls with the dealer so they can be logged and patched.
